trustRules: The target title, count, six placeholder rows, statuses and relative times are structure only and never runtime facts.
List title and count come from the current news.list payload after the active local category filter.
A source chip uses article.sourceName only when sourceUrl is present; otherwise it shows 来源不可用 and the row remains blocked for source navigation.
Official or verified wording is shown only from explicit verificationStatus, sourceTier or sourceBadges on that article and is never assumed from the route query.
translationStatus=llm is labeled 机器翻译, not human translated; unknown or missing translation state remains 待核验.
Published time uses the real publishedAt value formatted as an absolute month/day label; target relative-time placeholders are not copied.
All probed articles currently lack imageUrl, so rows use one neutral document medallion and never fabricate WoW objects or article imagery.
The footer says 原始来源 rather than 官方 because community results are a valid query outcome.

categoryRules.label: 全部
categoryRules.predicate: all articles returned by the current route query

categoryRules.label: 官方
categoryRules.predicate: verificationStatus=official_verified or sourceTier=official or sourceBadges explicitly contains 官方已核验

categoryRules.label: 蓝贴
categoryRules.predicate: sourceName=Blizzard Forums; official status alone is insufficient

categoryRules.label: 更新
categoryRules.predicate: explicit tags include content-update, hotfix, patch, ptr or class-change

categoryRules.label: 活动
categoryRules.predicate: explicit tags include event, trading-post, weekly or rewards

categoryRules.label: 社区
categoryRules.predicate: sourceTier=community, a community tag, or an explicitly non-Blizzard community source

mappings.target: 资讯列表 with back control
mappings.runtime: fixed route title 资讯列表 and deterministic back navigation

mappings.target: placeholder title, count and 订阅/筛选
mappings.runtime: payload title, filtered count and 刷新列表 action
forbidden: claim subscription without a subscription backend

mappings.filterControl: toggle newest-first and oldest-first using publishedAt; it does not claim advanced server filtering

mappings.runtime: first six truth-adapted articles after category and sort; 加载更多 increases the visible window by six
mappings.fallback: six stable loading rows or zero populated rows plus the terminal empty mode

mappings.conflict: target visibly combines six populated rows with an empty-state panel

resolution.more: show real remaining count and 加载更多 when filteredCount > visibleCount
resolution.complete: show 已显示全部 plus 刷新 when filteredCount > 0 and no rows remain
resolution.empty: show 暂无符合条件的资讯 plus reset/retry only when filteredCount = 0
resolution.loading: preserve the region with loading copy while the six row slots are mounted

forbidden: show 空状态 beside populated rows

mappings.target: 仅供参考 · 请以官方最终信息为准
mappings.runtime: 仅供参考 · 请以原始来源为准
mappings.reason: the route may contain community sources

stateContract.loading: mount header, summary, six categories, six stable row slots, terminal region and disclaimer at final geometry
stateContract.ready: show real filtered count, up to six visible truth-adapted rows and the correct terminal mode
stateContract.partial: preserve all regions and mark each affected article source/status independently
stateContract.stale: preserve cached payload and label route/rows as local fallback without claiming current freshness
stateContract.blocked: preserve all regions, expose the backend reason and offer retry in the terminal region
stateContract.error: preserve all regions and offer deterministic retry without a duplicate content tree
stateContract.empty: render zero populated article rows, keep six row slots visually reserved if required by the H5 loading gate, and use the terminal empty mode
